title: QA Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description:**

  

As a Software Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive test planning, test execution, and defect management. You will work closely with developers and product teams to identify and address potential issues early in the software development lifecycle. You will be expected to write automated tests using Python and the Robot Framework, contribute to test processes, and manage end-to-end testing to ensure our software products deliver the best user experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Test Planning & Strategy:
  + Develop comprehensive test plans and test strategies for software applications based on requirements and specifications.
  + Define test cases, test data, and create a clear roadmap for testing activities.
* Automated Testing:
  + Write, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Python and Robot Framework.
  + Design and develop reusable and scalable automated tests for both functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., performance, security).
  + Integrate automated tests with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
* End-to-End Testing:
  + Lead and perform end-to-end testing for the entire software product, ensuring that all parts of the system work together as expected.
  + Conduct regression testing, smoke testing, and functional testing across multiple environments.
  + Identify, reproduce, and document defects and work with development teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Test Execution & Reporting:
  + Execute both manual and automated test cases across various platforms (web, desktop, etc.).
  + Track, report, and prioritize defects and issues found during testing, ensuring proper communication with relevant teams.
  + Ensure thorough test coverage by validating the full functionality of the product, including edge cases.
* Continuous Improvement:
  + Collaborate with development teams to improve the testing process, quality practices, and automation strategies.
  + Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to continuously improve testing workflows.
* Collaboration & Communication:
  + Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, review user stories, and ensure proper test coverage.
  + Provide detailed feedback and suggestions to the development team to enhance the quality of the product.

**Requirements:**

  

* Educational Qualifications:
  + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Relevant Experience:
  + 3-7 years of experience as a Software Quality Engineer or equivalent.
* Technical Skills:
  + Proficient in Python programming for test automation and scripting.
  + Strong hands-on experience with Robot Framework for automated testing.
  + Solid understanding of Test Process and Test Lifecycle (requirement analysis, test planning, test execution, defect management, etc.).
  + Experience with end-to-end testing of software applications, ensuring full coverage of all functionality.
  + Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and integrating tests into automated pipelines.
  + Knowledge of version control systems like Git and experience with branching and merging strategies.
* Testing Experience:
  + Strong background in manual testing (functional, regression, smoke, and system testing).
  + Experience in automated testing, with a deep understanding of test frameworks and tools.
  + Familiar with test case design, test execution, and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail).
  + Exposure to performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner) is a plus.
* Soft Skills:
  + Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  + Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  + Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.
* Nice to Have:
  + Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  + Experience with medical device/biomedical device is a plus.
  + Exposure to agile methodologies and familiarity with Agile tools like Jira, Trello, or Asana.

**Fortive Corporation Overview**

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe. Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a skilled and motivated **Full-Stack AI Engineer** with hands-on experience in Python-based application development, modern frontend frameworks, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.

The ideal candidate should be capable of developing end-to-end AI-powered applications, building scalable backend services and intuitive user interfaces, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), and implementing AI-driven workflows. The candidate should have a strong foundation in software engineering, problem-solving, and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable, production-ready solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end full-stack applications using Python backend frameworks and modern frontend technologies.
* Build RESTful APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using React.js or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Design and integrate Machine Learning and Deep Learning models into real-world applications.
* Develop Generative AI solutions using LLMs, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Design and implement AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
* Integrate AI models and services through APIs, including cloud-based AI platforms.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, data processing pipelines, and external service integrations.
* Develop efficient, maintainable, secure, and scalable code following software engineering best practices.
* Perform debugging, testing, performance optimization, and deployment of applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver AI-driven business solutions.
* Explore emerging AI technologies and contribute to technical innovation and continuous improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **1. Full-Stack Development**

* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Hands-on experience with at least one Python backend framework: FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Experience building REST APIs, integrating third-party services, and implementing backend business logic.
* Working knowledge of React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, or an equivalent modern frontend framework.
* Understanding of frontend-backend integration, authentication, application architecture, and state management.

### **2. Machine Learning and Deep Learning**

* Understanding of core Machine Learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, regression, clustering, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with Deep Learning concepts and neural network architectures.
* Hands-on experience with libraries such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.

### **3. Generative AI and LLM Applications**

* Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or other equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and context management.
* Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document processing.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and response quality optimization.

### **4. Agentic AI and AI Workflows**

* Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and state management.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Knowledge of multi-agent systems, planning, task decomposition, and tool integration.
* Ability to build AI workflows that interact with APIs, databases, and external systems.
* Understanding of agent evaluation, error handling, observability, and reliable execution.

### **5. Databases, Cloud, and Deployment**

* Working knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases and vector databases.
* Understanding of Git, version control, debugging, and testing.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and application deployment.
* Exposure to cloud platform (Microsoft Azure).
* Understanding of application security, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of relevant software engineering or AI application development experience.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, learn new technologies quickly, and collaborate effectively with a team.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.

  

**DISCLAIMER AND NOTIFICATION**
-------------------------------

We (C5i) do not charge/accept any amount or security deposit from job seekers during the selection process or while inviting candidates for an interview.

**If you meet our position requirements and can see yourself at C5i, we invite you to apply by e-mailing your resume and cover letter to us at** **careers@c5i.ai****. Please include the job title in your subject line. We do not accept any hiring requests on phone.**

Please note that the hiring process at C5i is based purely on merit. If you are applying via any third-party recruitment site or agency, ensure that no monetary transaction is involved in the application/selection process.

title: Senior Platform Engineer

* Experience with the Agile mindset
* Experience working in virtual teams across multiple time zones with multiple cultures

title: Post-Doctoral Fellow - Materials Science
description:
GE Vernova Advanced Research is seeking a motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellow to advance our computational and experimental capabilities. This role focuses on bridging the gap between fundamental materials modeling and industrial application. The successful candidate will apply multiscale physics to predict the performance and degradation of high-temperature structural materials, including Ni-based superalloys and Thermal Barrier Coatings (TBCs), as well as various energy-related materials. The role involves integrating simulation insights with experimental validation to drive the development of next-generation materials, including the optimization of existing materials for critical supply chains and the design of novel manufacturing pathways.This is a fixed term position for 9 months.

**Job Description**
===================

**This role focuses on bridging the gap between fundamental materials modeling and industrial application. The successful candidate will apply multiscale physics to predict the performance and degradation of high-temperature structural materials, including Ni-based superalloys and Thermal Barrier Coatings (TBCs), as well as various energy-related materials. The role involves integrating simulation insights with experimental validation to drive the development of next-generation materials, including the optimization of existing materials for critical supply chains and the design of novel manufacturing pathways.**

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

  

* **Develop and execute continuum-scale models to simulate material performance, transport phenomena, and degradation kinetics.**
* **Partner with laboratory teams to characterize material properties, validate model inputs, and correlate simulation predictions with empirical data from in-house tests.**
* **Apply your knowledge in Mechanical & Materials engineering to work on innovative solutions for the GE Vernova product portfolio.**
* **Learn required tools/processes and perform advanced simulations, validating models against published external results and in-house experimental data.**
* **Deliver on assigned project tasks with minimal guidance, document results, and provide actionable insights for material optimization.**
* **Collaborate with the team to improve materials management, evaluate existing materials for critical supply chains, and enhance sustainability for GE Vernova products.**
* **Perform literature surveys and assess the state-of-the-art landscape in material technologies, design, and manufacturing to guide R&D project direction.**
* **Apply AI/ML techniques to map processing-structure-property relationships to accelerate the discovery and improvement of advanced materials.**
* **Utilize atomistic simulations as a complementary tool to resolve fine-scale mechanisms that inform and refine larger-scale models.**
* **Apply systems thinking to understand the impact of material behavior at the component and system levels and actively participate in team efforts to achieve collective project goals.**
  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* **Education: Recently completed Ph.D/Submitted Ph.D Thesis, in Materials Science, Metallurgy, or a related field ing (< 11 months post completion of Ph.D Defense)**
  

* **Modeling Expertise:**
  + **Advanced proficiency in continuum modeling software, specifically COMSOL Multiphysics, and experience with other relevant commercial or open-source simulation packages.**
  + **Demonstrated experience in property prediction models and thermodynamic/kinetic modeling (e.g., CALPHAD).**
  + **Proficiency in Python for scientific programming, data processing, and model automation.**
  + **Experience applying AI/ML techniques for material property prediction and design optimization.**
  + **Familiarity with atomistic simulation methods (e.g., DFT, MD) to supplement continuum studies.**
* **Experimental Background: Proven experience in a laboratory setting with the ability to interpret characterization data to inform modeling parameters.**
* **Domain Knowledge: Solid foundation in metallurgy and high-temperature materials. Familiarity with energy materials, fuel cells, or energy storage technologies is an asset. Expertise in material design and manufacturing processes.**
* **Communication: Strong ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and articulate complex technical findings to diverse stakeholders.**

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a **Data Science Manager** with strong expertise in data science, statistical analysis, primary research, and survey-based analytics. The role will lead data-driven initiatives from research design and data collection through advanced analysis, modelling, visualization, and business recommendations.

The ideal candidate should be able to translate business and research questions into analytical frameworks, design and analyze surveys, derive actionable insights from structured and unstructured data, and communicate findings effectively to senior stakeholders.

  
  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
--------------------------------

* Lead end-to-end **data science and analytics projects**, from problem definition and research design to insights and recommendations.
* Design and support **primary research studies**, including research objectives, hypotheses, questionnaires, sampling approaches, and analytical frameworks.
* Analyze **survey and primary research data** to identify trends, patterns, customer preferences, behaviors, and key drivers.
* statistical techniques such as **hypothesis testing, regression, correlation, segmentation, factor analysis, cluster analysis, and significance testing**.
* Develop predictive and machine learning models where appropriate to support business decision-making.
* Perform data cleaning, validation, transformation, exploratory data analysis, and statistical interpretation.
* Design and analyze **customer/market surveys, employee surveys, NPS/CSAT studies, brand research, and market research datasets**.
* Develop analytical frameworks to measure customer satisfaction, loyalty, preferences, purchase behavior, market perception, and other business KPIs.
* Identify relationships and patterns across demographic, behavioral, transactional, and survey variables.
* Lead the creation of **dashboards, reports, data visualizations, and executive-level insights**.
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Work closely with business, market research, product, technology, and data engineering teams.
* Ensure research methodology, data quality, statistical validity, and analytical rigor.
* Mentor Data Scientists and Analysts and establish best practices for analytics and research.
* Identify opportunities to leverage **AI, ML, automation, and GenAI** to improve research and analytics processes.
  

  

**Required Skills**
-------------------

  
  

### **Data Science & Analytics**

* Strong experience in **Data Science, Statistical Analysis, and Advanced Analytics**.
* Strong proficiency in **Python or R**.
* Advanced **SQL** skills.
* Experience with statistical and machine learning techniques.
* Strong understanding of data preparation, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
* Experience with data visualization tools such as **Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms**.

### **Primary Research & Survey Analytics**

* Strong understanding of **primary research methodologies** and research design.
* Experience in designing and analyzing **surveys/questionnaires**.
* Knowledge of **sampling techniques, sample size determination, weighting, survey bias, and data quality**.
* Experience analyzing Likert-scale, categorical, ordinal, and continuous survey data.
* Strong knowledge of **hypothesis testing, significance testing, regression, segmentation, factor analysis, and cluster analysis**.
* Ability to convert research objectives into analytical frameworks and actionable insights.
* Experience with market research, customer research, consumer insights, or similar research programs is preferred.

### **Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong ability to translate business questions into **data-driven analytical solutions**.
* Excellent storytelling and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate statistical and analytical findings to **non-technical stakeholders**.
* Experience managing multiple projects, teams, timelines, and stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **SPSS, SAS, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, or other survey/research platforms**.
* Exposure to **market intelligence, customer insights, consumer analytics, or competitive intelligence**.
* Experience with cloud data platforms such as **Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or Google Cloud**.
* Exposure to **GenAI/LLMs and AI-assisted analytics**.
* Experience working with large-scale survey, customer, market, or behavioral datasets.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to team:**

Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.

The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.

We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.

  

As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Agents
description:
**About Prodigal**
------------------

Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations.

We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.

These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?

Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.

Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.

Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.

We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.

We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and deploy **LLM-powered AI agents (including voice agents)** in production, designed for real-world use cases
* Own the **end-to-end lifecycle** of AI systems — from problem scoping and design to deployment, monitoring, and continuous iteration
* Design and optimize **prompts, RAG pipelines, and evaluation frameworks** to improve accuracy, latency, and reliability
* Work directly with **customers and Implementation Managers (IMs)** to understand workflows, solve real-world problems, and drive successful go-lives and iterations

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 1–3 years experience in **backend / data / AI engineering**
* Strong in **Python + SQL**
* Experience or exposure to **LLMs, RAG, or prompt engineering**
* High ownership, ability to **work in ambiguity and ship fast**
* Comfortable working with **customers and cross-functional teams**

**Preferred Qualification**
---------------------------

* B.Tech, BE, or M.Tech in Computer Science or a related discipline, with 1–3 years of relevant experience

**Bonus**
---------

* Experience with **production LLM systems / AI agents**
* Familiarity with **evaluation, agent tooling, or voice AI**
* Experience with **Databricks, MongoDB, or distributed systems**
* Startup or **customer-facing engineering** experience

**Why This Role**
-----------------

* Work on **real production AI systems (not demos)**
* **End-to-end ownership** and fast iteration cycles
* Direct impact on **enterprise customers and business outcomes**

Mode of Work - In-Office

From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.

To learn more about us - please visit the following:

Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/

title: Ontology Specialist - Data & AI
description:
* Lead the design and implementation of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs across business domains, including product and engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and operations.
* Define graph schemas, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies and semantic models aligned with the enterprise lakehouse, Power BI, AI/ML pipelines and business applications.
* Integrate structured, semi-structured and unstructured data using Python, Spark/PySpark, SQL and orchestration pipelines; enable entity resolution, relationship extraction and graph enrichment.
* Develop graph queries and analytics using SPARQL, Cypher, Gremlin and KQL graph semantics; optimize indexing, partitioning, caching and query performance.
* Integrate knowledge graphs with Azure OpenAI, Copilot and agentic AI frameworks to support semantic grounding, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval and explainable AI outcomes.
* Establish ontology lifecycle governance covering semantic consistency, metadata, lineage, stewardship, versioning and change control in partnership with domain experts.
* Act as technical authority and thought partner for ontology, knowledge graph and semantic architecture initiatives.

 **Requirements**

* 8+ years in Data Engineering, data architecture or related areas, including at least 3 years of hands-on Enterprise Ontology, Knowledge Graph or Semantic Architecture experience.
* Strong expertise in RDF/RDFS, OWL, SPARQL, SHACL and SKOS, with experience using ontology modeling tools such as Protege or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience with Neo4j or similar graph platforms and working knowledge of Cypher, Gremlin, SPARQL and graph performance optimization.
* Practical experience with lakehouse/data lake architectures, Azure data services or Microsoft Fabric, plus Python, PySpark and SQL.
* Experience with GraphRAG, vector databases, hybrid retrieval and integration with Azure OpenAI or other LLM-based platforms.

title: MF Platform Support-Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
What you will do

* Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems by identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
* Design, deploy, and integrate end-to-end infrastructure solutions across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments to ensure seamless operations.
* Automate workflows, processes, and system tasks to improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and operational consistency.
* Assess technical risks proactively and implement preventive measures to minimize disruptions and maintain business continuity.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Architects, Project Managers, and technical specialists, to deliver successful project outcomes.
* Lead infrastructure projects from planning through execution, ensuring high-quality delivery within agreed timelines and customer expectations.
* Communicate technical solutions and architecture recommendations effectively to customers and stakeholders, building trust through measurable business impact.
Continuously expand expertise in cloud technologies, enterprise IT systems, and emerging technologies while pursuing professional certifications and career growth opportunities.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important-you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused-someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless-naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

Required skills and experience
  

* 8+ years of experience and deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain
* In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System

  
Preferred skills and experience
  

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
* Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The **Senior AI Evals Test Engineer** is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including **adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement**. The engineer will **design scalable evaluation pipelines**, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is **70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing**, and sits within the **Applied AI: Test Engineering team** as a key technical authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Design and build agent evaluation frameworks** — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
* **Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies** to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
* **Build golden datasets and test harnesses** — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
* **Establish eval-as-a-service** — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
* **Automate regression and drift detection** — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
* **Define eval taxonomies and rubrics** — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
* **Instrument production observability** — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
* **Benchmark and select models** — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
* **Analyze and interpret evaluation results**, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
* **Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies** — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
* **Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts** (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
* **Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects**, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
* **Evaluate new technologies and patterns** (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
* **Partner with policy and legal teams** to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
* **Provide technical leadership to engineers**, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
* **Collaborate cross-functionally** — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* **8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience**, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
* **2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building**, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
* **2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy,** quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
* **1+ years** in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

### **Technical Skills**

* **Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation** — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
* **Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns** — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
* **Production experience with eval pipelines** — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
* **Proficiency in Python** — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
* **Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service** relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
* **Statistical literacy** — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
* **Enterprise product sensibility** — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
* **Excellent communication** — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows**, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

### **Tech Stack:**

* **Languages:** Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
* **Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright**
* **LLM Providers:** Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
* **Eval Tooling:** DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
* **Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries:** LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
* **Infrastructure:**DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge**: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
* **Data Analysis:** Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
* **Policy Background:** Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
* **Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools**: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
* **Experience testing complex APIs,** especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
* **Experience with prompt injection (Must)** and data poisoning skills is a plus
* **Certifications in AI/ML**, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning.AI specializations and software testing methodologies

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* **Proven ability to lead without direct authority**, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy.
* **Experience working in agile environments**, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones.
* **Excellent communication and documentation skills**, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders.
* **Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills**, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains
* Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms
* Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)
* Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison)
* Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams
* Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology
* Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing — design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a highly motivated Principal Engineer to design, architect, and lead Data Engineering initiatives within the HR Information Technology organization. This role requires a hands‑on technologist who can anchor critical initiatives to drive operational excellence and enhance employee and customer experience.

The Principal Engineer will provide technical leadership across the design, development, and operationalization of Data and Generative AI solutions, while shaping the enterprise HR data strategy. This role will oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient data engineering solutions across the HR data ecosystem, enabling advanced analytics, AI‑driven insights, and next‑generation HR capabilities. The Principal Engineer will also act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing architecture decisions, solution design, and implementation strategies to ensure alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long‑term technology strategy.

**In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

* 7+ years of progressive engineering experience with sustained hands‑on expertise in architecture, system design, and end‑to‑end solution development.

* Drive innovation by introducing emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices to improve decision‑making, automation, and predictive insights.
* Strong background in AI, Machine Learning, GenAI, including retrieval systems, embeddings, chunking strategies, and agentic AI workflows.

**Job Expectations:**

* Enterprise Technical Stewardship
  + Act as a Principal Engineer and strategic advisor to senior leadership, shaping technology decisions that impact multiple lines of business and the broader enterprise.

  + Remain deeply hands‑on—designing, reviewing, and occasionally coding critical components to set a high engineering bar.

  + Serve as a visible technical spokesperson internally and externally, presenting ideas, architectures, and innovation narratives with clarity and conviction.
  + Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising the overall technical maturity of the organization.
  + Foster a culture of engineering excellence, curiosity, and continuous learning.
* Outside‑In Innovation
  + Continuously scan the external ecosystem to bring new ideas, technologies, and patterns into the enterprise in a pragmatic, value‑driven manner.
  + Challenge legacy thinking and advocate for simplification, modernization, and platform thinking.
  + Balance innovation with operational stability, risk management, and long‑term sustainability.
* Data Engineering
  + Responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining metadata‑driven, scalable, high‑performance data engineering frameworks that power critical data ecosystem in the HR space.
  + Define and execute the enterprise data engineering roadmap aligned to business priorities.
  + Mentor data engineering teams delivering scalable, secure, and high quality data solutions.
  + Partner with architecture, product, analytics, and risk teams to drive data driven decision making.
  + Track industry trends, evaluate relevant tools/platforms, and adapt the best practices,

  + Drive the strategy, adoption, and governance of AI and GenAI capabilities across HR initiatives.
  + Partner with product, data, risk, and security teams to ensure responsible, explainable, and scalable AI solutions.
  + Identify high‑value use cases and guide teams from proof‑of‑concept to production at scale.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Why This Role Is Different
  
JLL is one of the world's leading professional services firms specializing in real estate and investment management, operating across 80+ countries. Our Corporate Functions Technologies (CFT) Finance team is at the forefront of transforming how JLL manages its global financial operations — and this role sits at the heart of that transformation.
  
**Here's what makes this different:** Most Order-to-Cash roles are ERP configuration and steady-state delivery. This one isn't. As Director of O2C Product Design with AI Innovation, you will shape the design and strategy of one of the first agentic AI transformations inside JLL's finance technology organization — systems that make invoicing, collections, and cash-application decisions autonomously, not just execute fixed rules.
  
As a key member of our existing O2C product focused team and working in conjunction with our JLL finance teams and our external delivery and vendor partners your role will be responsible for the delivery of various enhancements across O2C delivering the evolution of JLL's billing, accounts receivable, and contract management capabilities across our global PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 platform.
  
As a subject matter expert, you will own design authority before delivery — signing off that AI/integration initiatives are properly designed for business value and enterprise robustness before they enter build, not after. And you'll do this with direct exposure to senior Finance Technology leadership and meaningful influence over JLL's Accelerate 2030 strategic programme.
  
If you want to design a real, production-scale case study in enterprise agentic AI at a Fortune 500 global services company, this is where it's happening.
  
  
About the Team
  
The CFT O2C team is responsible for the end-to-end product strategy, design, and delivery of JLL's Order to Cash platform — spanning contracts, billing, accounts receivable, and third-party integrations across a single global PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 ERP instance.
  
The team supports core finance operations across 60+ countries and works closely with Finance, Engineering, and Production Support to deliver continuous improvement and strategic transformation at global scale. This role is a named contributor to JLL's Accelerate 2030/Enterprise Business Objectives (EBO) strategy, with direct accountability against the platform-modernization and data/AI pillars.
  
What's Different at Director Level
  
This role carries distinct authority and scope compared to senior product or delivery roles:
  
Design authority before delivery — you own the design roadmap and sign off that AI/integration initiatives are properly designed for business value and enterprise robustness before they enter build, not after
  
Cross-portfolio scope — spans billing/order processing, accounts receivable, and third-party integrations, rather than one workstream
  
Build-vs-buy decision authority — make and defend recommendations on AI and automation tooling, with clear input to procurement decisions and alignment with our Finance partners and Delivery partners
  
Direct leadership visibility — present design and investment roadmaps to senior Finance Technology leadership directly
  
Transformation leadership — guide the organization through AI-enabled process redesign, not just system configuration
  
Strategic Context
  
This role supports the O2C modernization program currently underway across billing, accounts receivable, and integration workstreams — translating strategy into a coherent design roadmap where AI and integration initiatives are proven out for business value before entering delivery.
  
You will operate at the intersection of finance operations, enterprise technology, and AI innovation, with significant input to how JLL deploys agentic automation across financial processes that directly impact working capital, revenue assurance, and client experience.
  
What You Will Do
  
1. Product Strategy & Design Leadership
  
Support the end-to-end O2C product design strategy — from concept through launch and iteration — grounding every design decision in measurable business benefit
  
Direct the design, modification, and evaluation of O2C solutions across the portfolio (billing, accounts receivable, third-party integrations), guiding teams toward well-defined, optimal outcomes
  
Partner with Product Owners and Product Support in balancing current-state support with forward design work
  
Build and maintain a performance framework that provides visibility into design quality, process efficiency, and business value delivered
  
Present strategic roadmaps and investment cases to Finance Technology leadership and O2C Steering Committee
  
2. Order to Cash & Order-to-Billing Design
  
Guide design of core O2C enhancements including contract asset handling, credit note automation, and client onboarding, ensuring solutions meet requirements with minimal post-deployment defects
  
Identify and prioritize opportunities to streamline billing and contract processes through digitization and automation design, including agentic AI capabilities
  
Ensure all design decisions support financial close, month-end reporting, and revenue assurance requirements across 60+ countries
  
Design solutions that maintain compliance with regional regulatory requirements and internal controls
  
3. AI, Agentic Automation & Integration Design
  
This is the core differentiator of this role
  
Research and propose GenAI use cases across O2C — intelligent cash application, proactive collections optimization, automated dispute resolution, working-capital forecasting — each backed by a feasibility assessment on JLL's internal data/AI platform, validated with Engineering
  
Build ROI-based business cases for GenAI and automation initiatives in partnership with Finance operations partners, demonstrating measurable impact on DSO, dispute resolution time, and working capital
  
Make and defend build-vs-buy decisions on AI and automation tooling, with clear recommendations on vendor selection, platform integration, and total cost of ownership
  
Extend agentic workflow design across integration touchpoints — including invoicing and remittance automation with third-party systems (payment gateways, banks, treasury platforms, CRM systems) — from concept to production

title: Responsible AI Solution Risk Assessor
description:
**Overview**  

Are you passionate about advancing the positive impact of AI on a global scale? In this position, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our AI initiatives are implemented responsibly and effectively.

Our Trust and Integrity Protection (TrIP) team works with other parts of Microsoft to ensure we continue to be one of the most trusted companies in the world. We are seeking a detail-oriented and principled Responsible AI Solution Risk Assessor to be part of a team evaluating AI use cases across our organization. This role is critical in ensuring that AI solutions are developed and deployed in alignment with Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards. You will work closely with the Office of Responsible AI and other governance bodies to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with AI technologies.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  
**Responsibilities**  

* Risk Assessment Ownership: Lead the Responsible AI risk assessment process for AI projects within your purview.
* Use Case Evaluation: Analyze proposed AI solutions for ethical, privacy, and security risks, including identifying sensitive use cases (e.g., facial recognition, biometric analysis, or legally sensitive applications).
* Escalation Management: Determine when use cases require escalation to internal review boards such as the Deployment Safety Board or other governance entities.
* Approval Coordination: Ensure all necessary approvals are obtained before development or deal sign-off, maintaining alignment with internal Responsible AI policies.
* Documentation & Compliance: Maintain thorough documentation of risk assessments, approvals, and mitigation strategies to support audit readiness and compliance.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with product teams, legal, compliance, and engineering to ensure risk considerations are addressed early in the development lifecycle.
* Policy Integration: Translate Responsible AI policies into actionable assessment criteria and workflows.
* Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the evolution of risk assessment frameworks and tools based on emerging technologies and regulatory changes.

  
**Qualifications**  

### **Required Qualifications (RQs)**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Ethics, Law, Risk Management, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in risk assessment, compliance, or governance roles, preferably in AI or emerging technologies.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.

### **Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Risk Management, Engineering, Government Intelligence, Security, or Information Technology, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Risk Management in the context of Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Analyst, Consulting, Auditing, Privacy, Security, Compliance, Government Intelligence, and/or Finance OR equivalent experience.
* Experience with internal governance processes such as AI review boards or safety panels.
* Knowledge of privacy-preserving technologies and bias mitigation techniques.
* Background in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance, government).
* Certifications in AI ethics, compliance, or risk management.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Principal Professional, Database Management
description:
